## About Me

**Software Engineer** with 5+ years of experience building business platforms, operational systems and AI-powered products. I work across frontend, backend and product engineering, helping companies design and deliver software that supports real business operations.

### Engineering Highlights
- Built a complete livestock management platform (MeuBoi) from scratch
- Designed API contracts and technical documentation
- Developed AI-powered WhatsApp automation systems
- Implemented payment integrations with Stripe
- Created ETL processes and data migration pipelines
- Delivered Progressive Web Apps for offline-first usage

## Professional Experience

### Software Engineer II @ R2A Cobrança Pecuária (MeuBoi) | Dec 2025 – Mar 2026
Led end-to-end development of MeuBoi, a livestock management platform centralizing cattle registration, genealogy tracking, financial operations, and herd management workflows. Architected backend and frontend using Go, TypeScript, Next.js, and Supabase. Designed PWA capabilities and real-time analytics dashboards for offline-first access. Developed API contracts, technical documentation, and ETL processes using Swagger and Docusaurus.

**Tech:** Go · TypeScript · Next.js · Supabase · PostgreSQL · Python · PWA · Swagger · Docusaurus · Discord Webhooks

### Software Engineer II @ Astriia | Sep 2024 – May 2025
Designed AI-powered customer interaction workflows integrating OpenAI and WhatsApp Business APIs. Built backend services for conversational AI, customer engagement, and subscription management. Implemented Stripe payment flows increasing annual conversions by 28% and reduced internal process execution time by 35%.

**Tech:** Node.js · Express · Next.js · OpenAI API · WhatsApp Business API · Stripe · Python · Discord Webhooks · Facebook Business API

### Software Engineer II @ WhatsUpper | Aug 2023 – Dec 2023
Developed intelligent automation solutions for WhatsApp Business API. Built scalable backend services using Node.js for high-volume message processing and interactive chatbot experiences.

**Tech:** Rocket.chat · Firebase · Next.js · WhatsApp API · Facebook Business API · Twilio

### Software Engineer II @ Stone | Oct 2022 – Jul 2023
Optimized DialogFlow routines integrated with Rocket.Chat, improving chatbot response speed by over 50%. Developed interactive SPA with jQuery for customer routing and WhatsApp-based checkouts, cutting queue times by up to 20%.

**Tech:** Rocket.chat · Hasura · Next.js · WhatsApp API · Facebook Business API · Twilio · Firebase · DialogFlow · Google Cloud Platform

### Systems Development Analyst I/II @ Cenário Capital | Oct 2020 – Sep 2021
Developed and maintained critical financial systems for data analysis and process automation. Collaborated with analysts to translate requirements into functional software solutions. Progressed from Junior to Mid-level role.

**Tech:** jQuery · HTML · CSS · JavaScript · React · HTML for Email Marketing · Next.js

### Front-end Developer I / Jr. Marketing @ Marry Perry | Feb 2020 – Sep 2020
Developed and enhanced e-commerce platform UI for responsive and intuitive shopping experience. Implemented front-end features improving user engagement and conversion rates. Assisted marketing team with landing pages, email templates, and affiliate systems.

**Tech:** HTML · CSS · JavaScript · Node.js · Express · MySQL · Python

### Soldier @ Brazilian Army | Mar 2016 – Apr 2017
Developed discipline, resilience, and high-pressure performance skills. Mastered teamwork and communication through collaborative daily operations and mission-critical exercises.

### Why don't you use another language besides JavaScript?
JavaScript is my safe space. I'm very comfortable with it and I can write almost anything without having to check complicated documentation.

I'm a Software Developer and Front-end specialist. Outside of technology, I'm a columnist at Onigiri Hardcore and a Taekwondo athlete.

## What is a Netrunner?

A netrunner is a **cyberpunk hacker** who navigates and manipulates the digital world using advanced cybernetic implants. The term originated in William Gibson's 1982 short story "Burning Chrome" and was expanded in his 1984 novel ***Neuromancer***.

The term was popularized by the **Cyberpunk 2020 role-playing game** (1988), where netrunners could directly interface with cyberspace.

### Why I Use This Identity
1. **Digital Fluency:** Navigating complex codebases and distributed systems
2. **Strategic Thinking:** Analyzing systems, finding weaknesses, executing precise solutions
3. **Full-Stack Hacking:** Operating across the entire digital ecosystem
4. **Cultural Connection:** Interests in technology, gaming, Japanese culture
5. **Underdog Spirit:** David vs. Goliath narrative of indie hackers and builders

---

## Warrior of Darkness and Hikikomori

### Warrior of Darkness
- **Final Fantasy XIV:** Neutral force balancing light and darkness
- **Dungeons & Dragons:** Dark Knight prestige class – black magic, formidable combatant
- **Appeal:** Power through darkness, solitude, intellectual sophistication, neutrality

### Hikikomori (引きこもり)
- **Definition:** Japanese term for "pulling inward, being confined"
- **Characteristics:** Avoids social contact, confines to home for 6+ months
- **First Described in Japan, Now Global:** Cases reported in Oman, India, US, Brazil

### Why I Use This Identity
1. **Warrior of Darkness side:** Navigating complex systems, building things with intelligence and sophistication
2. **Hikikomori side:** Spending significant time in solitude, focused on work, study, and creative projects
3. **Identity:** *"warrior of darkness, net runner, hikikomori and software engineer"* – navigating digital worlds, working in isolation, wielding technical power, and building things
